title: ITVX / Full bus wrap
slide_intent: Adapt an identity device to an irregular moving surface while keeping a readable service mark, because viewers need to recognize the same service across different situations.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen continuity between campaign recognition and service use.
demonstration: A double-decker bus uses yellow and dark angular fields across its body, with ITVX and programme imagery spanning the side.
practical_value: Adapt an identity device to an irregular moving surface while keeping a readable service mark.
